small_guidance: The addmm kernel uses allow_tf32=False which forces slower fp32 mma; switch to allow_tf32=True (or tf32) for the Conv1D matmuls and add larger autotune configs (BLOCK_M=128/BLOCK_N=256, num_warps=8, num_stages=4) tuned for GPT-2 shapes (M=8192, N in {768,2304,3072}, K in {768,3072}). Also fuse the bias-add and (where applicable) the GELU into the epilogue of addmm_kernel to remove a full read/write pass over the 32x256x3072 activation tensor.
large_guidance: Redesign around a persistent, split-K-free GEMM specialized for GPT-2's fixed hidden sizes (768/2304/3072) using tl.dot with tf32 and a fused epilogue that handles bias + (optional) NewGELU and (optional) residual add in one kernel, eliminating the separate gelu pass. Additionally fuse the final lm_head matmul (which reuses wte weights) and consider a fused attention kernel (FlashAttention-style) to replace the QKV projection + softmax + attn matmul block, since standalone Conv1D replacements leave the attention softmax/matmul on the PyTorch path.
